falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern requires lower highs and contained resistance; a breakout above 5,600 invalidates the structural similarity and suggests the correction phase has already resolved bullishly, making 'UNKNOWN/HOLD' wrong as the bottom was already in

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression to pre-correction levels would indicate fear has fully dissipated and the market has repriced to complacency, falsifying the 'bottom not yet confirmed' signal and proving the August pattern match was a false positive

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further to -75bps or wider (more negative)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion amid a 77% bottom pattern match would signal the market is pricing acute recession risk rather than a soft-landing correction, invalidating the 'HOLD' verdict as the macro regime has shifted to something the pattern engine cannot capture

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
